description.en: Drive OriginLab Origin from DSH chat via MCP: 62 tools for scientific plotting and analysis. Modal-dialog watchdog, LabTalk destructive-command gate, release/reconnect; fit with initial/fixed/weighted params; fine-grained plot/sheet edits (remove/swap curves, sort, transpose); matrix tools; FigureSpec declarative YAML (diff-able, replayable); MCP Resources read-only session snapshot; matplotlib-figure bridge; PowerPoint assembly with panel labels; OriginLab Graph Gallery template search; EPS export; file-access whitelist; pytest suites (Origin-aware skip); 12-image dHash visual regression baseline; editable OPJU delivery with deterministic readback verification. Windows with a local Origin installation required (2026 tested).
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中通过 MCP 驱动本机 OriginLab Origin 画图与分析：62 个工具。模态对话框看门狗、LabTalk 破坏命令门禁、释放/重连；拟合初值/固定参数/加权；细粒度图与工作表编辑（删曲线/换数据源/排序/转置）；矩阵工具；FigureSpec 声明式 YAML（可 diff 可重放）；MCP Resources 只读会话快照；matplotlib 图桥接；PowerPoint 组图（面板字母）；OriginLab Graph Gallery 模板搜索下载；EPS 导出；文件访问白名单；pytest 测试套（无 Origin 自动跳过）；12 张视觉基准 dHash 回归；可编辑 OPJU 交付与确定性反读验证。需 Windows 且本机已安装 Origin（2026 实测）。
